concepts.title: 1. Свободный стол
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished, readable in-game BATTLE SCREEN concept for an original fantasy card game, landscape 16:9, screenshot without device frame, not a poster or menu. Image1: approved MAIN MENU material/style reference only, do NOT copy its menu layout or giant altar ring. Image2: established creature card frame template reference only. Image3: actual "Вихревой грифон" wind-griffin art, Image4: actual "Каменный жук" earth-beetle art. Keep recognizable creature art and established card faces. Match dark teal stone tabletop, bronze chamfered UI rims, warm ivory readable Russian type, vibrant painterly card art. No decorative leaves or vines on interface, no extraneous scenery dominating the usable board.
GAMEPLAY MUST BE ACCURATE: Two players fight with physical portrait cards on an inclined perspective 3D table. Opponent hand at TOP has FOUR identical face-down backs, no revealed opponent hand. Local player's FOUR face-up cards form an accessible fan along the BOTTOM: field "Зал смирения", ability "Своя земля", ability "Разрыв условия", ability "Манёвр". Only TWO active field cards total: one owned by local player OPEN in the main battle area and one owned by opponent CLOSED off to the far side, with no creature on it. Never draw six field slots, lane grids, extra occupied fields or piles that look like more active fields. Both battling creatures belong to the SAME OPEN field "Горная тропа"; clearly group the ONE open field card and TWO opposing creature cards in one softly outlined active battle area. Show local earth "Каменный жук" base135 + field40 = current175; opponent wind "Вихревой грифон" base205 + field30 = current235. Both card faces, power badges and field condition remain visible, no full card occlusion. Physical creature cards may flank the central field in a shared marked area so ownership and common battlefield are unambiguous. No giant 3D summoned creatures outside cards. Readable central field summary "Горная тропа" and "Земля +40 · Ветер +30". Emphasize OWN versus OPPONENT using restrained teal versus amber owner-edge accents, not red health bars.
HUD: match score "Вы 1 : 1 Соперник", small caption "До 3 побед", turn state "Ваш ход" and phase "Битва". Three small victory pips per player, one lit each. Current primary button "Готов". Field already open: show subdued noninteractive status "Поле открыто", NOT an active "Открыть поле" button. Do not show "Конец хода" at the same time as battle Ready; do not show Cancel unless targeting. Small gear/pause button top corner. Separate understandable piles, discreetly labeled "Сброс", "Выбывшие", "Убранные поля", mirrored for each player with owner markers where needed; piles never disclose hidden removed field faces. At least one accessible "Журнал" control / compact log according to layout. Sample log lines may read "Началась битва", "Открыто поле «Горная тропа»". Any supplemental details must be legible, no walls of tiny lorem ipsum. No mana/energy costs, HP/hearts, hero portraits, timers or countdown not in current implementation, draw deck, shop, ranked badges, invented rules or flashy damage numbers. End-game elimination is not depicted. No tutorial overlay. This is a UI concept, changes appearance only. Clear safe margins, hand never covers main actions, all cards distinguishable and controls practical for mouse/touch. Single screen only; no numbered collage. LAYOUT A — OPEN CLASSIC TABLE: the usable perspective stone tabletop fills almost the whole screen. Minimal floating HUD, tiny top-center score bar, clear slim turn ribbon just below opponent hand. Active battle cluster large in the center, local beetle card left of central field, opponent griffin right, other closed field farther back-left. Powers175 and235 shown as two small attached bronze badges near appropriate creature, not in a large side panel. Local hand spans the bottom middle in a gentle four-card fan with faces visible. The Ready button is a large tactile bronze-edged teal round/hexagonal control at the RIGHT edge midway down; field-open status nearby. Small labeled pile pads along outer table edges, with separate near/far owner zones. "Журнал" is collapsed at lower-left with a compact last-event line above it, leaving most of board unobstructed. Light carved element motifs on table corners, subtle center slate texture, no large decorative ring competing with cards. Balanced airy composition, visually calm premium game screenshot.
